summary: Implementation plan for the Import Completed Movies & TV Series feature in CineMax across Web and Android, supporting multi-format file upload (PNG/JPG/WEBP screenshots via server-side Gemini extraction, TXT, CSV, JSON, and raw text paste), intelligent TMDB candidate matching with interactive review and manual search correction, idempotent Supabase persistence preserving existing ratings/notes/favourites, and detailed import summary reporting with retry support.
